finding.claim: wipe() performs no authorization: requireRole() returns a boolean that is discarded, so any caller reaches repo.wipe(tenant).
finding.source: User u (any caller, including one with empty roles) and tenant path parameter from POST /tenants/{t}/wipe (per comment at Admin.java:24)

trace.note: void wipe(User u, String tenant) accepts caller and target
requireRole(u, "OWNER") called as a statement; boolean result ignored
requireRole is static boolean and only returns u.roles().contains(role); it does not throw

finding.guards_checked: requireRole at line 26 (return value discarded, no effect). No other check between lines 25 and 27. export() at line 32 uses checkRole, which throws, so the defect is local to wipe().

verdict.guard_found: none. requireRole at Admin.java:26 is a bare statement whose boolean return (defined at Admin.java:14-15, documented as not throwing) is discarded, so repo.wipe(tenant) at Admin.java:27 runs for any caller. The only other check, checkRole (Admin.java:18-22), is used by export() at line 32, not wipe().
verdict.reason: wipe() at Admin.java:26 calls requireRole, which only returns a boolean (Admin.java:14-15) whose result is discarded, so repo.wipe(tenant) at Admin.java:27 runs for any User, including one with no roles, and the only file in the directory is src/Admin.java, so no route-level gate is visible.

finding.claim: Role checks are not scoped to the target tenant: a user holding global OWNER can export or wipe any tenant (plausible; depends on how roles are populated, which is not in this directory).
finding.source: Authenticated User u holding role "OWNER" for some tenant; tenant string from URL path
finding.sink: repo.export(tenant) at Admin.java:33 (data exfiltration); repo.wipe(tenant) at Admin.java:27 (destruction)

trace.note: User record has roles Set<String> and no tenant field, suggesting roles are global
void export(User u, String tenant) takes tenant from the URL path
checkRole(u, "OWNER") tests set membership only, never compared to tenant
repo.export(tenant) runs for any tenant the caller names

finding.guards_checked: checkRole at line 32 (throws when role absent, but not tenant-aware). No tenant-membership check in this file. Any such control would live in the router, the role-assignment code, or the Repo implementation, none of which is present.

verdict.guard_found: No tenant-aware control in src/Admin.java. checkRole (Admin.java:18-22) tests set membership only, and requireRole (Admin.java:14-16) is a bool-returning check whose result is discarded at Admin.java:26, so wipe() has no guard at all. Repo.wipe/export (Admin.java:7-8) receive only the tenant string, so they cannot bind the caller to the tenant. The only remaining candidate is a router-level tenant-membership check, and the router is not in this directory.
verdict.reason: Admin.java:4 (User has no tenant field) and Admin.java:32-33 (checkRole tests a global role set, then repo.export(tenant) runs on the path tenant) match the trace, and no guard in this file blocks it, but Admin.java:31 is only reachable through a router that is not in this directory, so whether roles are per-tenant or a router enforces tenant membership cannot be settled here.
